name: Sonic rifle
body:
Source Technology Guide pg. 21
Statistics
Cost 26,000 gp
Type two-handed ranged; Proficiency exotic (firearms); Weight 6 lbs.
Damage 1d10 (small), 2d6 (medium); Damage Type Sonic; Critical x2
Range 150 ft.; Capacity 20; Usage 1 charge; Special Automatic, touch
Description
A sonic rifle is a larger, more powerful version of the sonic pistol, and functions as such except for the differences listed here.
Construction
Craft DC 27; Cost 13,000 gp
Craft Technological Arms and Armor, military lab
